title: Tobin aka Flame Master
about: Tobin the Mountain Dwarf warlock, his pet dragons Speak and Talk, and everything he needs. Medium armor comes from Mountain Dwarf. Load it, then press 'Start as Tobin aka Flame Master'.

look.tagline: Fire, fury, and two dragons that never stop talking.

card.name: Pact Magic
card.desc: Your spell slots come back after a SHORT rest!

card.name: Dragon Strike
card.desc: ROAR! Speak and Talk dive in together! A glob of sludge hits a creature within 20 ft: 1d6 acid and it's STUCK (Con save DC 13 at the end of each of its turns to break free). Plus a 30-ft cone of slippery ice: anyone in it, or who steps on it later, makes a Dex save (DC 13) or falls down. Then they fly off again.

card.name: Dark One's Blessing
card.desc: When you knock an enemy down to 0 HP, you get {DOB} shield HP (temporary).

options.name: Agonizing Blast
options.desc: +{CHAN} damage on every Flame Blast (already counted).

options.name: Fiendish Vigor
options.desc: Give yourself 12 shield HP (temporary). Recast any time to refill to 12.

options.name: Devil's Sight
options.desc: See perfectly in darkness, even magical darkness, up to 120 ft.

options.name: Pact of the Chain: Speak & Talk
options.desc: Your two pet dragons ride along with you, scout ahead, and never stop chattering.

options.name: Alert
options.desc: +3 initiative (already counted). After everyone rolls, you can swap initiative with a friend.

options.name: Savage Attacker
options.desc: Once per turn when a Flame Blast or weapon hits, roll the damage twice and keep the higher.

options.name: Tough
options.desc: Extra-hard to knock down (talk to your DM about the HP).

card.desc: Shoot {BEAMS} of fire (at one enemy or two). Roll to hit for EACH one: {SPATK}. Each hit does 1d10{EBADD} fire.
Understand any language you hear or read for 1 hour.

card.name: Hellish Rebuke
card.desc: Someone hurt you? Hellfire! Dex save (DC {DC}), {S} fire, half if they save.

card.name: Fly
card.desc: Up to {S} of you and your friends can fly (60 ft) for 10 minutes.

card.name: Hold Person
card.desc: Up to {S} people: Wis save (DC {DC}) or frozen stiff. Hits up close are crits!

card.name: Counterspell
card.desc: Stop an enemy's spell! (Big spells need a roll.)

card.name: Prestidigitation
card.desc: Little magic tricks: sparks, smells, clean or warm things, light a candle.

card.name: Minor Illusion
card.desc: Make a fake sound or a fake little object.
Climb walls and ceilings like a spider for 1 hour.

heroes.name: Tobin aka Flame Master

flame_pact: Pact of the Chain: Speak & Talk

inventory: Silver dagger (it was Mamma Uba's - keep it shiny!)
heroes.notes:
My dragons are my family (even when they won't stop talking).
Fire fixes most problems.
A dwarf never breaks a promise.
Mamma Uba believed in me first.
Chaotic Good. Dragons: Speak & Talk.
